vacancies.descEn: Applications are invited from all Sri Lankan citizens, including Government and Semi-Government officers, for a Management Assistant (Supporting Staff) post under the Miscellaneous Foreign Aided Project (MFAP) — a Project Management Unit based in Colombo implementing road construction and development activities. Appointment is on a contract basis, subject to Management Services Circular No. 02/2026.
vacancies.descSi: ප්‍රවාහන, මහාමාර්ග හා නාගරික සංවර්ධන අමාත්‍යාංශය යටතේ ක්‍රියාත්මක විදේශ ආධාර ව්‍යාපෘතියක (MFAP) ව්‍යාපෘති කළමනාකරණ ඒකකය සඳහා කළමනාකරණ සහායක තනතුරට අයදුම්පත් කැඳවනු ලැබේ. පත්වීම කොන්ත්‍රාත් පදනමින් වේ.
vacancies.qualEn: G.C.E. O/Level in 6 subjects with 4 credit passes (incl. Language, Maths and two others) in one sitting, with a G.C.E. A/Level pass in one sitting.
vacancies.qualSiText: එක් අවස්ථාවකදී විෂයයන් 6ක සා.පෙළ සමත්වීම (බස, ගණිතය ඇතුළුව සම්මාන 4ක්) සහ එක් අවස්ථාවකදී උ.පෙළ සමත්වීම.
howToApply: Fill in the application using the format in Annex 1 of the notice. Apply separately for each post.
Enclose your academic qualifications, work experience and copies of the certificates for every qualification you claim. Only qualifications with certificate copies are considered.
If you already hold a permanent public-sector post, send the application through your head of institution with their release consent and recommendation (para 2.3.3 of MSD Circular 02/2026).
Write the post and project name on the top-left corner of the envelope.

Send it by registered post to the Secretary, Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, “Maganeguma Mahamedura”, No. 216, Denzil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha, Koswatta, Battaramulla, or hand it to the Ministry's Administration Division, on or before 24.09.2026.
Enquiries: 011-2271048.
requiredDocuments: Copies of certificates for every qualification claimed
Head of institution's release consent and recommendation (serving public officers only)

vacancies.instEn: Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited (AASL)
vacancies.descEn: The role involves planning, design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of airport electrical systems and associated control infrastructure, ensuring uninterrupted, safe, and efficient operation in compliance with international and national regulations. It includes technical leadership, project management, system performance analysis, energy management, and supervision of engineering staff in a 24/7 airport environment.
vacancies.qualEn: a) Should possess 4 years full time B.Sc. Degree in relevant specialized field in Engineering from a university recognized by University Grant Commission (UGC). AND b) Should possess Membership at the level of Associate Member (AM) or higher category of Institution of Engineers Sri Lanka (IESL). AND c) A minimum of 1 year post qualifying experience as an Engineer in relevant Field. (After obtaining the 4 years full time B.Sc. Degree)
howToApply: Prepare your CV in the specimen application format on airport.lk (Corporate > Careers).
Enclose copies of the relevant certificates.
Write the post applied for on the top-left corner of the envelope.

Send it by registered post or courier to the Chairman, Airport & Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited, Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake, to arrive on or before 1 October 2026.
requiredDocuments: CV in the specimen format from airport.lk

vacancies.descEn: The role involves contract administration and supervision of construction projects at airports and other stations, managing projects to ensure completion within time, cost, and quality standards, and performing duties such as reviewing shop drawings, certifying payments, and serving on bid evaluation committees.
